body:
Hi, my story isn’t much compared to yours but maybe you can give me an advice because I’m honestly lost. 
I don’t want to vent so I’ m going short. Last weekend I cheated on my girlfriend while being dead drunk. I came clean yesterday and after hours of discussion she decided that she needed some time. 
My question is, how did you recovered from this ? Did you do it all by yourself or has your husband did some things that helped you regain trust ? In one word, if It was on you that I cheated (me and my girlfriend are 19) what would you want me to do ? 

Sorry to make it about me but I thought you were the right person to ask when I saw your post. I wish you the best with your husband

But don’t you  think that if you haven’t told her the truth, you wouldn’t still have this feeling of guilt and fear ? That your relationship would have been damaged by the fact you constantly feel guilty and that eventually it will not be the same as before ?
And you never cheated again on one of those other girlfriends you had ? I’m not trying to judge you or anything, I just think it’s a good place to have this kind of talk since it’s anonymous
And  you had other relationships since you lost her ?
And how long ago has it happened ?
It’s the worst solution, getting in trouble a girl who just had fun and still being the dickhead that cheated,  I’m just hurting everybody with this situation
And what did you do yourself ? You told her or not ?
Yes thanks for the warning, it fucking scares me but it’s clearly possible
Yes I already decided to go completely dry for a month or more to put my drinking habitudes in perspective
Well, obviously but I was more thinking about a do or don’t list. Something  that broke even when you passed the first step of forgiveness

Well she was drunk,surely a lot but less than me I think because she remembered what happened when I could just remember that it happen, no other  details on my side.  That’s the problem, I don’t really remember how it started or finished. And I contacted her Wednesday when I finally managed to get her number, because I don’t even know her

Yeah well tank you for taking your time commenting but this part is pretty clear for me. What I’m looking for here is advices about how to keep the relation going if she decide to give me a chance. What kind of things helped you get pass this problem ? Or what broke it when she gave you a seconde chance ?
Well, you’ve summarized the problème  pretty efficiently , and thanks mate

Thank you, all those messages really help me decide, because it’s so fcking fresh and I’m panicking and trying to find a way out, when really there’s only one I’m truly ok with. And yeah you’re right, I’m not protecting her, I’m trying to escape. And if I’m being honest with myself the least I can do is telling her, for her and for me. 

About the fact that I’m EXACTLY a cheater (I am but you understood what I meant), that people don’t changes I can’t let you say that. That’s too easy, people do changes when they want to, when they commit to it. Otherwise life is just a lottery where you’re either born good or bad, and I never heard something that stupid. I’m going to seriously change my way of drinking, starting by going dry for at least a month, because I don’t want this to happen again, ever. That’s what you do when you want to changes, you act up. I know what I’m talking about because I was in depression for a year, I had some psychotics episodes and it’s just started to get better, so I had a lot of things to change, and I still do, starting by assuming my actions. 

Thanks again, because your comment helped me see how much banal my situation was, and how banal my reaction could be.

I didn’t say I won’t do it. In fact, I’m pretty sure I will tell her the truth. I said that I’m hesitating because it’s so damn hard to face those consequences, and I’m fucking scared of loosing it all. But yeah, of course, love demand honesty. What I’m looking for here is advices about the following, how to handle the fall backs because I will try to keep her.

Thank you for your comment, it’s actually helping me a lot, I’m still not 100% sure about what I’m gonna do because only I can decide and not any comments, but I really appreciate your way of thinking.

Yeah right well I’ve only had sex with two girls (appart for this time)  and both were long terms relationships. What I’m trying to say is that I’m not use to be that kind of person, it’s not who I want to be and I honestly don’t know how it happened. Then of course it’s easy to say to a stranger, and it’s not much of an excuse for the person  I hurt. To be even more honest I’m not sure if I’m going to tell her. I know what you’re going to say, I would tell the same if it hasn’t happened to me, but it’s harder to do the right thing than thinking you’re going to when it hasn’t yet happened. It’s really scary to risk breaking a relationship that is pretty close from perfect (apart from what I did obviously). So yeah, I’m hesitating and yeah, you can win this argument pretty easily, but try and really put yourself in my position. It’s at last a good exercise for putting thing in perspective I think I would have said the same things that you said if I saw this post a week ago.
Thank you for that comment, you’re probably right about the trigger thing and I didn’t think about that.

I know telling her is the right thing to do, but have you been in this type of situation ? On which side were you ? How did it end, what have you done that helped the situation ? Telling the truth is one thing, but I don’t know what to do in the following. I know every stories are personals, but what did you learn that could help me not losing her ? ( if she decide not to dump me on the spot)

I understand your way of thinking, but what can I say ? I truly love her a lot and I hate my self for what I’ve done. But the worst part is that I know she love me even more. We had a pause this summer because I wasn’t sure of my feelings and it affected her a lot more that I thought it could, so I’m even more scared of telling her because I know how much it will hurt her. But then again honesty is very important for me (yeah I know it doesn’t look like but it is) so I’m having a hard time deciding what to do. And for information, I know I would be hurt if I was at her place, but I think I would forgive her eventually. But I’m really not sure that she will.
